description: This file defines a mock class for the IInterfaceDetailsIterator interface, used in unit testing to simulate the behavior of the actual iterator. It includes mock methods for iterator operations such as Next, Previous, Reset, IsValid, Count, Current, and reference counting methods AddRef and Release.

classes.name: MockIInterfaceDetailsIterator
classes.description: A mock class implementing the IInterfaceDetailsIterator interface for testing purposes.

methods.name: Next
methods.description: Simulates moving to the next interface detail. Returns true if successful.

methods.name: Previous
methods.description: Simulates moving to the previous interface detail. Returns true if successful.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the iterator to a specified position.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Checks if the current iterator position is valid.

methods.name: Count
methods.description: Returns the number of interface details.

methods.name: AddRef
methods.description: Increases the reference count for the iterator.

methods.name: Release
methods.description: Decreases the reference count for the iterator.

methods.name: QueryInterface
methods.description: Queries for a specific interface ID.
